entries.$comment: The conformance kit and the fault-injection/clock helpers (plan §6.2, §13.1). It imports bun:test, so a consumer checks it with Bun's types.
The HTTP response cache (plan §9): cacheResponse, coalesceRequests and addCacheTags for bun-common's BunRouter. Its declarations import bun-common, a runtime dependency.

The Worker the Cloudflare drivers' endpoint points at, which users deploy (plan Status, PR-C10). It runs on Cloudflare's runtime, so it is checked as a browser entry: no Node or Bun types in its graph, and it imports nothing.
